notes: Five own pages read, all HTTP 200. The pricing page (key cce1f978b3f58384) and the CRM product page served prices in Indian rupees only (the server appears to localize by location), so USD price claims could not be compared like with like from them; the pricing page is listed in needs_browser_read for a USD read even though it is not thin, and C01, C04, C05 and C07 stay unverifiable. USD prices for Standard ($14 annual) and Professional ($23) come from Zoho's own CRM guide page (key 479f305b4da4d9ea), which was cited by one answer. The help-center edition guide cited by six answers rendered no text (thin) and is listed in needs_browser_read. The fetch tool flagged the zoho.com home snapshot as a possible challenge page because its HTML loads a Cloudflare challenge-platform script, but the page rendered its normal content (3,710 characters), which was used. Names: Zoho and Zoho CRM are the vendor's names and were not coded; Blueprint was treated as a feature name (its plan placement is coded in C12). C06 is true because the published $14 starting price lies inside the approximate $12 to $14 range. Illustrative lines such as "a $14 seat that your team actually uses beats a $150 seat" (crm|2|Claude|1 and 2) and Gartner or review recognition were not coded. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): both pages in needs_browser_read were read once in a real browser (pricing page key cce1f978b3f58384.browser, USD prices Standard US$14, Professional US$23, Enterprise US$40 under a Monthly/Annually toggle; edition guide key 9e34e21cbf227d71.browser, last updated 5 May 2026, with an edition comparison table). Re-classed C01 (Enterprise $40) and C17 (cadences on Standard) from unverifiable to true, and C24 (Zoho Analytics) to true on the guide's list of Zoho apps bundled in CRM Plus; C11 and C12 now quote the guide. C04, C05, C07 and C14 stay unverifiable (no Ultimate USD price, no monthly-billing USD prices, no Zoho One price, no scoring-rules placement). Gap lines and comparison tables add no new in-scope statement about Zoho CRM: the uncovered table cells repeat C02 and C04 for records already listed, and the rest are opinions or illustrative figures.
